hypotheses.reasoning: The third-party geo-IP provider (api.geoip.example) began returning 503s and 502s, and some calls timed out, starting at 19:11:22. enrichment-svc depends on it and degraded, so ingest-api returned 503 and ingest-gateway passed 503s through to clients from 19:11:23 onward. The circuit breaker opened, and its later probes kept getting 503/502 back, which shows the provider itself was down. Nothing mentions the provider before 19:11:22.
Some provider calls hung for the full 10s instead of failing fast.

verdict.recommendedAction: Contact the geo-IP provider or check its status page. Meanwhile, make enrichment-svc skip geo enrichment and let events through without it when the breaker is open, instead of failing ingest. Also consider a fallback or cached geo lookup.
